steps.body: Every 3-digit number has a word form too. 347 is "three hundred forty-seven" — hundreds first, then the tens-ones part.

widget.successFeedback: 5 hundreds, NO tens, 7 ones. The zero is not nothing — it is the guard that keeps the 5 in the hundreds place. Take it away and you have 57, a completely different number.

predict.reveal: The zero holds the tens spot OPEN: drop it and the 5 slides next to the 7, collapsing 507 into 57. A placeholder zero contributes nothing to the total and everything to the meaning.
